summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-accessible public universe around the ABF/FC-BGA substrate-materials node. The strongest node-specific control points remain Ajinomoto for ABF insulating film and MEC Company for copper-to-resin adhesion / surface-treatment chemistry. Because both are foreign issuers available mainly through OTC/ADR-style US access, the discovery lane should be handled as liquidity- and disclosure-sensitive. Ibiden is included as a reference substrate-maker/customer anchor, while Element Solutions is included as a US-listed underfollowed chemistry/platform candidate with IC-substrate copper plating, copper adhesion, and surface-finish exposure that requires deeper validation versus MEC's reported dominance.
